ideas.pitch: A 2D puzzle platformer where players manipulate two parallel timelines simultaneously to deliver packages across broken obstacles.
ideas.title: Quantum Courier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on polished core mechanics and immediate browser playability, matching the fast-paced jam winning pattern.

ideas.pitch: An audio-driven browser adventure game designed for accessibility where players navigate a dark dungeon entirely using voice commands and spatial sound cues.
ideas.title: Echo Labyrinth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages unique input mechanics and accessibility focus, similar to voice-controlled winners that stand out in crowded jams.

ideas.pitch: A chaotic time-management cooking minigame built in React featuring rapid-fire retro mechanics and token-like modifier cards.
ideas.title: Glitch Chef
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses familiar retro arcade styling with high replayability, aligning with successful mini-game and retro jam entries.

ideas.pitch: A choice-driven educational browser game where players manage water resources and infrastructure to protect a fictional ecosystem.
ideas.title: BioSphere Keepers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to judges looking for meaningful impact and narrative depth combined with smooth browser rendering.

ideas.pitch: A live generative browser game that morphs its world layout dynamically based on rapid state changes and minimalist pixel art.
ideas.title: Chrono Canvas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an innovative live-adaptation technical loop that catches judges' attention during short evaluation windows.
